rules.coverage: A retained constraint is assessed only if the exact predeclared observable/control exists for that member. Finiteness or response magnitude alone does not satisfy it.
rules.next_batch: only if an already frozen finite member and an unassessed needed observable/control coexist
rules.nonunique: A pass, non-rejection, common, mixed, or partial response remains a retained constraint; it is not discarded merely because it is not unique alone.
